insights: The market experienced a significant structural shift in the last week, jumping from a ~1480 baseline to a new ~1770 plateau, indicating a surge in new graduate hiring initiatives.
While general software engineering roles are showing slight stagnation, specialized fields like security and data/ML are demonstrating consistent growth, suggesting a pivot toward high-skill demand.
The sustained gap between the 7-day average (1766) and the 30-day average (1539) confirms that the current momentum is a recent, strong trend rather than a temporary fluctuation.
